scope.implemented: wire-v10 bounded immutable mesh epochs separate from contact/pose descriptors; zero mesh retransmission on COM-only changes; authoritative PRIMARY retained geometry and explicit compatibility identity; exact snapshot/descriptor pairing; current rotating body frame for PRIMARY and fleet meshes
scope.not_implemented: arbitrary per-asset network deltas, general incremental GPU residency, full authored designs/materials/textures or wing appearance, continuous PRIMARY interpolation across COM frame revisions, prediction/reconciliation, external networking/reconnect, complete native/Bevy parity
scope.licensing: asset identity, authority policy, wire resolution and native integration remain GPL; MIT protocol only adds a numeric message kind/version; no game code moved into engine crates
scope.dev_dependency: flight-net tests reuse the existing workspace toml dependency for the canonical authority fixture

contracts.wire: ProtocolVersion 10; kind 10 descriptors carry labels, contacts, body-local part poses and epoch-local mesh IDs; kind 11 carries a complete bounded immutable active mesh epoch; v7/v8/v9 envelopes rejected
contracts.descriptor_pairing: PRIMARY Snapshot.geometry_revision and FleetSnapshot.geometry_revision name the exact descriptor revision; unknown/absent/omitted/mismatched PRIMARY appearance draws nothing, never an inferred X-15
contracts.primary_frame_revision: Snapshot.appearance_frame_revision advances only for PRIMARY render/frame changes; unrelated fleet and PRIMARY label changes retain interpolation; different PRIMARY frame revisions select the whole newer sample, not a blend of different COM origins
contracts.publication: exact mesh equality uses Arc identity then values; active mesh ordering survives reordered/split parts; COM/pose/label/contact changes reuse the cached encoded payload frame; actual active mesh-set changes publish a complete new payload epoch including unchanged survivors
contracts.mailbox: existing single writer, separate coalesced mesh/descriptor slots and persistent revision markers updated under one lock; payload drains before its descriptor; an unsent dependency survives pose-only coalescing; new subscribers get current complete dependencies
contracts.receiver: single reader, one bounded active mesh epoch and latest descriptor; resolves either arrival order before publishing the existing Arc-shared materialized FleetGeometry application API; skipped epochs never reuse another epoch's IDs; invalid matching IDs, reused/backwards revisions, malformed buffers or exceeded budgets fail closed
contracts.fleet_ingress: complete membership uses the same short bounded inbox lock as on-change catalogues rather than dropping a one-shot birth/removal on host-drain contention; no extra reader or per-tick polling system
contracts.budget_limitations: reference occurrences count against each vehicle's budget despite deduplication; bounds are post-deserialization, not a proof of hostile transient allocation safety
contracts.primary_identity: only the standard GPL FlightAuthority constructor declares the closed StarterX15 identity; custom/split constructors do not inherit it, even for identical names/physical definitions; retained geometry takes precedence and compatibility origin follows the existing resource-frame shift pipeline
contracts.gpu: server mode initially has no MeshRenderer/GPU source; declared PRIMARY and enabled fleet meshes share the existing device/queue/opaque renderer/pass/targets; common COM translations reuse source buffers; true layouts still rebuild the combined source and may reupload PRIMARY
contracts.coordinate_frame: both actual body meshes and fleet instances convert inertial render axes into the current rotating BodyFrame used by camera/terrain; nonzero-epoch hardware oracle checks both sides
contracts.disabled: renderer.fleet_meshes disables only secondaries, not PRIMARY; no fleet GPU source/history or retained old fleet catalogue in GPU source state; requested/resolved quality policy remains unchanged
contracts.diagnostics: HUD and flight telemetry expose primary_appearance=unknown|revision_mismatch|absent|omitted_budget|retained|explicit_starter_x15; existing mesh source-publication, draw, triangle, epoch-withheld and cull counters remain
